thoughts.text: Baru mulai. Narasinya pelan banget, I'm not sure I like the narrator yet.
Bagian dapur ini bikin kangen rumah Eyang. The smell of the kitchen is basically a character.
Dia nulis “rumah itu tidak pernah benar-benar kosong” and I had to stop reading for a bit. Ternyata gue bacanya sambil mikirin Ibu terus.
I think this book is less about leaving than about who stays. Naratornya masih nyebelin, tapi sekarang gue ngerti kenapa.
Pelan-pelan aja bacanya. I don't want this one to end.
